summary.text: Terry Stier is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 22B, with a tenure beginning in 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Stier has a career in law enforcement and has served as a police chief.

paragraphs.text: Terry Stier was born in Minneapolis and graduated from Belle Plaine High School.
He earned an associate degree from Normandale Community College in 2001, and his career experience includes working in law enforcement.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Stier said he began his law enforcement career in 2003 and rose through the ranks to chief of police.
Stier succeeded Brian Pfarr in District 22B and took office on January 14, 2025.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy, Judiciary Finance and Civil Law, and Rules and Legislative Administration committees.

In the same survey, he said he would continue to focus on public safety and Second Amendment rights, and cited removal of a three-year waiting period for cost-of-living increases for retired police officers and firefighters as an accomplishment of his first term.
